text:
Maya Patel: OK team — quick thread to lock the ops for next week's Satellite Meetup booth and the related webinar follow-ups. High level: swag staging, speaker confirmations, lead routing, and the benchmark post we want to publish day-of.

Maya Patel: Attaching the short checklist I promised in the deck earlier: 1) final swag qty + staging location 2) speaker slide deadline 3) courier pickup window 4) lead QR flows & webhook test 5) day-of staffing rota.

Jon Rivera: Swag update: printer delivered 800 stickers, 300 tees (S-XL mix), 50 hoodies. Actual on-hand counts in #logistics are: stickers 798, tees 298, hoodies 50.

Jon Rivera: I put a CSV export in Google Drive -> /marketing/swag/satellite-2026-inventory.csv and flagged low shirt sizes. Can we bump smalls by 20?

Priya Nair: Speaker status: we have 3 confirmed talks (Maya, Alex K, Lina). Waiting on 2 acceptances (CloudTeam & PartnerX). Slide deadline = Tue 9am PT. Priya -> I emailed both speakers with a gentle nudge and the slide template.

Sam O'Connor: Booth layout: 6ft table + rolling monitor. Need two power strips, one ethernet, and floor tape for the demo queue. Can ops confirm availability?

Devin (ops): Confirmed: 2 power strips reserved, ethernet ticket created (net-4321). Courier pickup booked for Wed 3:00pm -> FedEx tracking 1234ABCD (label created). Please use this pickup window: Wed 14:30-15:30 local.

Maya Patel: Awesome. Devin — can you also stage a small "returns" bag for leftover promo postcards and ensure we have pre-labeled return boxes? Last time we lost 200 cards in transit.

Devin (ops): Yup — will add a "returns" box and marker. Also set up the return label printer at staging. Command I ran: `ship create --to venue --items swag,postcards --pickup Wed14:30` (for ops reference).

Priya Nair: Lead routing plan: scan QR -> short form -> webhook to HubSpot. I'm testing webhook now. Sample payload below: `{"email":"test@acme.com","source":"satellite-booth","interest":"benchmarks"}`. If everyone is happy, I'll run a smoke test Wed 10am.

Jon Rivera: Slight messaging tweak for the benchmark narrative: change "20% speedup" to "~20% average token-latency improvement" in the booth card to avoid overclaiming. Also good to include the test harness link.

Maya Patel: Agreed on language. Priya, can the QR funnel tag session interest (benchmarks/webinar/demo) so we can route hot leads to Sales immediately?

Priya Nair: Yes — adding `interest` enum. Routing rules: webinar & demo -> SDR queue; benchmarks -> inbound nurture flow. I'll share mapping doc after smoke test.

Sam O'Connor: Staffing rota: Maya + Jon on morning shift, Priya + Lina on afternoon. Need one floater from Sales for heavy demo windows (11:30-13:30). @Devin can we get an extra chair? :chair:

Devin (ops): Extra chair added. Sales floater pinged (DM to @Eli).

CommBot: Calendar invite created: "Satellite Meetup — Booth Ops" Wed 08:30-17:00. Join link + staging address in invite.

Maya Patel: Content cadence: Publish the benchmark micro-post the morning of the event (short thread + one visual). Jon — can you finalize the visual asset by Tue EOD?

Jon Rivera: Will do. I'll post final PNG to /marketing/content/assets by Tue 6pm and add alt text.

Priya Nair: Webinar follow-up plan: automated 3-email drip (thank you + benchmarks recap -> demo CTA -> case study). I need the webinar registration landing URL to wire into the first email. Maya — is that live?

Maya Patel: Landing page is live at https://redwood.ai/satellite-webinar. Put `?utm=booth2026` on booth QR links. Priya, use that URL for the first drip.

Sam O'Connor: Quick day-of ask: bring a small whiteboard for on-the-fly architecture sketches. Also a stack of 25 one-pagers about Dedicated + Private options.

Jon Rivera: Printed 25 one-pagers and pinned them in the staging bin.

Priya Nair: Smoke test time proposal: Wed 10:00am in staging. I'll send a calendar invite and post results here.

Maya Patel: Perfect. If WooCommerce/partners confirm speakers, we push a day-of tweet thread linking the micro-benchmark post and webinar registration at 9:30am. Jon — can you draft the 3-tweet thread?

Jon Rivera: Draft incoming by Tue noon. Will include CTA, benchmark stat (soft language), and webinar link.

Maya Patel: Last bits — who's owning lead handoff to SDRs post-event? Need one owner to triage high-intent leads and assign.

Priya Nair: I'll own triage for the first 24 hours, then hand to SDR lead @Eli for follow-up.

Devin (ops): FYI: courier updated pickup to Wed 15:10 (slight delay) — new tracking 1234ABCD -> 1234ABCD01. I'll update the staging sheet.

Maya Patel: THANKS all. If nobody objects, final action list: Jon finalize visual + tweets, Priya run webhook smoke Wed 10am + own 24h triage, Devin confirm pickup + returns box, Sam bring whiteboard + tape, Maya publish micro-post 9:30am and host the webinar follow-up plan.

Jon Rivera: Roger. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: Roger.

Devin (ops): Roger.

Sam O'Connor: Roger.

CommBot: Thread archived to #marketing/archives after 7 days."
